title: Calculate the Area of a Rectangle
description: Read the width and height of a rectangle as integers and print its area.
input_format: Two integers: width and height, separated by whitespace.

starter_code.Python:
width, height = map(int, input().split())
area = width * height
print(area)

learning_content.title: Variables, types and arithmetic
learning_content.intro: A variable stores a value under a name. Read both dimensions as integers, multiply them, and store the result before printing.
points: Read width and height from standard input.
Use integer variables because the input values are whole numbers.
Multiply width by height to calculate the area.
learning_content.note: The program performs a fixed number of input and arithmetic operations.

quiz.question: If width is 6 and height is 4, what area should the program print?

options.feedback: Adding the dimensions gives 10, but area requires multiplication.
Multiplying 6 by 4 gives an area of 24.
Subtracting the dimensions gives 2, not the area.
Concatenating the digits does not calculate the area.
